invocation_boundary_unverified.title: The invocation boundary could not be verified
invocation_boundary_unverified.description: Retained activity could not be attributed completely to this invocation. Usage and cost totals are withheld rather than treated as zero.
invocation_boundary_unverified.recovery: Inspect the retained Conversation and OpenTelemetry evidence and the original run Status. Do not infer missing usage or repeat a request merely to reconstruct its activity.

opencode_native_terminal_not_observed.title: The end of the OpenCode activity was not captured
opencode_native_terminal_not_observed.description: The captured native stream has no confirmed terminal event. This limits the activity record; it does not establish whether the task succeeded or failed.
opencode_native_terminal_not_observed.recovery: Inspect the retained Conversation and OpenTelemetry records and check the existing run status before starting another request. Repeating the task will not restore the missing capture.

opencode_adapter_telemetry_incomplete.title: Some OpenCode telemetry could not be captured
opencode_adapter_telemetry_incomplete.description: The adapter could not retain all expected telemetry. The remaining activity records may be incomplete; this warning does not establish task failure.
opencode_adapter_telemetry_incomplete.recovery: Inspect the retained Conversation and OpenTelemetry records and check the existing run status. Ask the operator to investigate the capture before relying on its completeness; do not repeat the task just to recreate telemetry.

langflow_loopback_required.title: The graph service must use a local address
langflow_loopback_required.description: The bridge is configured with an unsupported graph service URL.
langflow_loopback_required.recovery: Ask the operator to configure the local Langflow service using a loopback HTTP address, then check that the saved graph is accessible.

langflow_local_login_unavailable.title: The bridge could not sign in to Langflow
langflow_local_login_unavailable.description: The bridge could not obtain a local application login while reading the saved graph.
langflow_local_login_unavailable.recovery: Open the local Langflow app and sign in if prompted. Ask the operator to check the bridge connection and local login configuration before starting the graph again.

saved_flow_identity_unavailable.title: The saved graph could not be identified
saved_flow_identity_unavailable.description: The bridge did not receive a usable saved graph identifier.
saved_flow_identity_unavailable.recovery: Save the graph in Langflow and open that saved graph before running it. Check the existing execution before starting new work.

saved_flow_fetch_failed.title: The bridge could not read the saved graph
saved_flow_fetch_failed.description: The local graph service did not provide the saved graph, including after a single login refresh when authorization expired.
saved_flow_fetch_failed.recovery: Open the saved graph in Langflow and confirm you can access it. Ask the operator to check the bridge login and graph service connection before starting new work.

run_and_grant_store_must_differ.title: Run history and permissions need separate stores
run_and_grant_store_must_differ.description: The local workflow is configured to use one private file for both run history and permission grants.
run_and_grant_store_must_differ.recovery: Ask the operator to configure separate private files for run history and permission grants before starting this workflow.

invalid_handoff_artifact_selection.title: Selected artifact references could not be read
invalid_handoff_artifact_selection.description: The saved file selection must be a JSON list of file-reference objects.
invalid_handoff_artifact_selection.recovery: Open Selected Artifact References on the Handoff node and correct the JSON list. Use [] only if no files are intended. A connected selection takes precedence.

claude_telemetry_start_failed.title: Claude telemetry could not start
claude_telemetry_start_failed.description: The local runner could not start its telemetry receiver. This controller turn was not submitted.
claude_telemetry_start_failed.recovery: Install the runner observability dependencies and restart the local runner. Check recorded activity for any earlier turns before starting new work. Technical details retain the error code.

claude_telemetry_cleanup_unconfirmed.title: Claude telemetry cleanup is unconfirmed
claude_telemetry_cleanup_unconfirmed.description: The controller was stopped, but closing its local telemetry receiver or removing its temporary capability could not be confirmed. The agent may already have performed work.
claude_telemetry_cleanup_unconfirmed.recovery: Inspect the existing run and its recorded activity before starting new work. Restart the local runner after checking its telemetry cleanup; do not blindly repeat the task.

claude_telemetry_capture_failed.title: Some Claude telemetry could not be recorded
claude_telemetry_capture_failed.description: The local telemetry receiver could not decode or persist an export. The agent may already have performed work; its captured native activity remains available.
claude_telemetry_capture_failed.recovery: Inspect the existing run and any effects before starting new work. Check the local runner observability setup and available disk space. Do not blindly repeat the task.

agent_component_migration_required.title: This saved Agent node needs an update
agent_component_migration_required.description: This node inherits an older provider component. It was stopped before sending a request because its provider routing could be incorrect.
agent_component_migration_required.recovery: Replace the node with its current provider component, or migrate a copy of the saved flow with the module migration tool before loading it. Custom Agent subclasses must extend the shared AgentComponent.

workspace_command_output_too_large.title: The workspace command returned too much output
workspace_command_output_too_large.description: The isolated command exceeded its output limit. The runner stopped it and confirmed container cleanup before reporting this failure.
workspace_command_output_too_large.recovery: Check the current workspace changes before deciding whether to run another command. Limit the command output; the original command may already have changed files.

opencode_command_service_closed.title: The workspace command service has stopped
opencode_command_service_closed.description: This run no longer accepts workspace commands because its command service is closing or closed.
opencode_command_service_closed.recovery: Check the existing run status and workspace before deciding whether to start new work.

opencode_workspace_command_failed.title: The isolated workspace command could not finish
opencode_workspace_command_failed.description: The runner could not confirm the workspace command result. Its container was cleaned up before this failure was reported.
opencode_workspace_command_failed.recovery: Inspect the existing run and workspace changes. The command may already have changed files; do not repeat it automatically.

opencode_controller_output_failed.title: The Agent output could not be captured
opencode_controller_output_failed.description: The runner lost the controller output stream or its output exceeded the allowed limit. A completed Agent response could not be confirmed.
opencode_controller_output_failed.recovery: Check the existing run status and workspace changes before starting new work. Check Technical details for the stable error code.

opencode_container_configuration_invalid.title: The local OpenCode Docker connection is invalid
opencode_container_configuration_invalid.description: The runner could not use its Docker connection settings. The configuration is ambiguous or unsupported, so no controller was launched.
opencode_container_configuration_invalid.recovery: Check the local runner configuration and select a supported local Docker connection. Graph inputs cannot change that connection.

opencode_controller_image_unavailable.title: The OpenCode images could not be confirmed
opencode_controller_image_unavailable.description: The runner could not confirm the configured local controller and worker images. No controller was launched.
opencode_controller_image_unavailable.recovery: Check Docker is running and the approved images are available on the configured local connection. Then check the local runner configuration.

executor_lost.title: The isolated tool runner stopped
executor_lost.description: The Agent lost its separate tool container while the request was active. The work outcome is not confirmed.
executor_lost.recovery: Check the existing run and workspace changes before starting new work. Do not repeat the original request automatically; a tool may already have changed files.

auth_revoked_during_turn.title: The Agent connection is no longer authorized
auth_revoked_during_turn.description: The host detected that the account authorization changed while the Agent was working and requested cancellation. The remote work outcome may be unconfirmed.
auth_revoked_during_turn.recovery: Check the existing run and its changes. Reconnect the intended account through the local account setup before starting new work; do not repeat an uncertain request automatically.

permission_preflight_failed.title: The local runner sandbox could not be verified
permission_preflight_failed.description: The runner could not confirm the required workspace access and protected-file restrictions. No model request was submitted by this preflight check.
permission_preflight_failed.recovery: Check the configured runner image and its reviewed sandbox configuration. Keep execution disabled until the local runner preflight succeeds.

opencode_history_credentials_present.title: Native history export was stopped to protect account data
opencode_history_credentials_present.description: The dedicated OpenCode history store contains account or credential records. The runner refused to pass a database copy to the offline export container. Activity evidence is incomplete.
opencode_history_credentials_present.recovery: Keep the current run and its history. Check the dedicated local OpenCode profile configuration and use a separate session-only store; do not repeat the Agent task to repair history capture.

opencode_history_credentials_unverified.title: The native history store could not be verified
opencode_history_credentials_unverified.description: The history database schema did not match the expected credential-store checks. No database copy was passed to the export container. Activity evidence is incomplete.
opencode_history_credentials_unverified.recovery: Check that the configured OpenCode image and dedicated session store match the supported runtime. Preserve the existing history and do not rerun the task just to repair capture.

opencode_history_database_limit.title: The native history store exceeds its capture limit
opencode_history_database_limit.description: The dedicated OpenCode session database is larger than the configured host memory budget, so native history export was refused. Existing history is preserved and activity evidence is incomplete.
opencode_history_database_limit.recovery: The local user can raise LAOMEDO_OPENCODE_HISTORY_MAX_DATABASE_BYTES within the supported 512 MiB limit in runner startup configuration. For larger stores, preserve an archive and configure a separate dedicated session store for new work. Do not delete active history or replay the Agent request.

opencode_auth_redirect_rejected.title: OpenCode account configuration redirected unexpectedly
opencode_auth_redirect_rejected.description: The account configuration request redirected to another address. The local authentication adapter refused to forward the credential.
opencode_auth_redirect_rejected.recovery: Check the locally configured OpenCode Console address and resolve the unexpected redirect before loading account configuration again.

opencode_active_console_account_required.title: No active OpenCode account is selected
opencode_active_console_account_required.description: The local OpenCode Console account store has no active account with an organization selected.
opencode_active_console_account_required.recovery: Check the active account and organization in OpenCode Console, then refresh the local runner account configuration.

opencode_console_models_required.title: OpenCode returned an unusable model catalogue
opencode_console_models_required.description: The selected Console provider configuration contained no models or unsupported model identifiers.
opencode_console_models_required.recovery: Check the selected account and its provider model configuration before refreshing the catalogue. Do not substitute an unverified model identifier.

opencode_console_origin_not_allowed.title: The OpenCode Console address is not supported
opencode_console_origin_not_allowed.description: The locally selected account points to a Console address outside the supported HTTPS service boundary.
opencode_console_origin_not_allowed.recovery: Correct the local account configuration to use the supported OpenCode Console service. Keep credentials out of graph inputs.

opencode_model_endpoint_not_allowed.title: An OpenCode model uses an unsupported endpoint
opencode_model_endpoint_not_allowed.description: A model in the Console configuration selected an endpoint outside the permitted OpenCode inference boundary.
opencode_model_endpoint_not_allowed.recovery: Check the local provider model configuration and its inference endpoint before loading it again. Do not bypass endpoint validation.

opencode_model_sdk_not_allowed.title: An OpenCode model uses an unsupported SDK
opencode_model_sdk_not_allowed.description: A model in the Console configuration requested a provider SDK that this local adapter does not support.
opencode_model_sdk_not_allowed.recovery: Use a supported SDK in the local provider model configuration or update the adapter through a reviewed change.

opencode_organization_context_mismatch.title: The OpenCode organizations do not match
opencode_organization_context_mismatch.description: The returned provider configuration belongs to a different organization from the locally selected Console account.
opencode_organization_context_mismatch.recovery: Check the active account and organization in OpenCode Console before refreshing the local runner account configuration.

opencode_real_credential_required.title: The OpenCode account credential is missing or invalid
opencode_real_credential_required.description: The authentication adapter received an empty credential or a placeholder instead of a usable account credential.
opencode_real_credential_required.recovery: Sign in through the supported OpenCode account flow and refresh the local runner account configuration. Do not paste credentials into the graph.

git_workspace_path_invalid.title: The run workspace path is unavailable
git_workspace_path_invalid.description: Git preparation needs a new run-owned directory, but the destination already exists or is a link.
git_workspace_path_invalid.recovery: Check the configured source and run-state paths. Preserve unrelated files; use a new run directory after confirming existing work is stopped.

git_repository_root_required.title: The source is not a supported Git repository
git_repository_root_required.description: Git workspace mode requires a repository root with its own real .git directory; linked worktrees are unsupported.
git_repository_root_required.recovery: Choose a normal local repository root in the runner configuration, or use directory workspace mode.

source_commit_invalid.title: The source has no usable commit
source_commit_invalid.description: The runner could not resolve a valid source HEAD before preparing the workspace.
source_commit_invalid.recovery: Check that the source repository has a valid committed HEAD before starting new work.

source_index_invalid.title: The source index could not be read
source_index_invalid.description: The runner could not inspect tracked files safely before cloning the source.
source_index_invalid.recovery: Check the source repository with Git and resolve index errors before starting a run.

source_not_clean.title: The source has uncommitted changes
source_not_clean.description: The source contains tracked or untracked changes, so the runner refused to treat it as a pinned Git baseline.
source_not_clean.recovery: Commit, stash or otherwise preserve your source changes, then start a fresh run from a clean repository.

submodule_source_unsupported.title: The source contains a submodule
submodule_source_unsupported.description: This workspace mode cannot safely prepare a source index containing Git submodules.
submodule_source_unsupported.recovery: Use a source without submodules or directory workspace mode with the required regular files.

symlink_source_unsupported.title: The source contains a tracked link
symlink_source_unsupported.description: This workspace mode refuses tracked symbolic links before cloning.
symlink_source_unsupported.recovery: Use a source with regular files in place of links, or select a supported source.

tracked_skill_path_unsupported.title: The source tracks the reserved skills directory
tracked_skill_path_unsupported.description: The source tracks .agents/skills, which the runner reserves for pinned skill materialization.
tracked_skill_path_unsupported.recovery: Remove that path from the source index while preserving any files you need, then commit a clean baseline.

sparse_source_unsupported.title: The source uses a sparse checkout
sparse_source_unsupported.description: Git workspace mode requires the full source checkout and refuses enabled sparse-checkout configuration.
sparse_source_unsupported.recovery: Use a full clean checkout before starting new work.

git_clone_failed.title: The run repository could not be cloned
git_clone_failed.description: Git did not create an independent clone of the selected source. No prepared workspace was returned.
git_clone_failed.recovery: Check local Git availability and source access. Confirm failed-run cleanup before starting new work.

git_checkout_failed.title: The run baseline could not be checked out
git_checkout_failed.description: The cloned repository could not check out the source commit observed during admission.
git_checkout_failed.recovery: Check the source repository and local filesystem access. Confirm cleanup before preparing another run.

git_remote_removal_failed.title: The run remote could not be removed
git_remote_removal_failed.description: The runner could not remove the clone remote, so it refused the workspace before dispatch.
git_remote_removal_failed.recovery: Check local Git and filesystem access. Confirm failed-run cleanup before starting new work.

git_clone_verification_failed.title: The run repository did not match its baseline
git_clone_verification_failed.description: The final checkout commit or remote list did not match the isolated workspace requirements.
git_clone_verification_failed.recovery: Check the source repository and any local process modifying it. Confirm cleanup before starting a new run.

git_workspace_cleanup_unverified.title: Workspace cleanup could not be confirmed
git_workspace_cleanup_unverified.description: Preparation failed and the runner could not remove its partial workspace. The workspace is not admitted for execution.
git_workspace_cleanup_unverified.recovery: Check the failed run directory and any process holding its files before starting new work. Preserve unrelated directories.

git_workspace_snapshot_limit.title: The source is too large to snapshot safely
git_workspace_snapshot_limit.description: The Git workspace exceeded the supported snapshot byte or entry limit before a verified snapshot was produced.
git_workspace_snapshot_limit.recovery: Reduce the selected source to the files needed for this run; do not bypass the snapshot limits.

invalid_workspace.title: The workspace is unavailable
invalid_workspace.description: The selected working-state path is missing, is not a directory or is a symbolic link.
invalid_workspace.recovery: Check the configured source and retained run directory before continuing.

unsafe_workspace_entry.title: The workspace contains an unsupported file entry
unsafe_workspace_entry.description: Snapshot verification found a link, shared hardlinked file or other unsupported filesystem entry.
unsafe_workspace_entry.recovery: Use regular private files and directories for the source. Check retained run state before continuing.

workspace_copy_mismatch.title: The copied workspace did not match the source
workspace_copy_mismatch.description: The copied file tree failed its hash check. The runner did not accept that snapshot.
workspace_copy_mismatch.recovery: Check for concurrent source changes or filesystem errors before starting new work.

workspace_git_initialization_failed.title: The workspace baseline could not be created
workspace_git_initialization_failed.description: Local Git could not initialize or commit the private file baseline required for this run.
workspace_git_initialization_failed.recovery: Check that Git is installed and can write to the runner state directory before starting new work.

workspace_git_metadata_conflict.title: The copied workspace already contains Git metadata
workspace_git_metadata_conflict.description: Baseline initialization found an existing .git path and refused to replace it.
workspace_git_metadata_conflict.recovery: Check the configured workspace mode and source. Use Git workspace mode for a supported full repository.

cleanup_path_outside_run_state.title: The cleanup path is outside this run
cleanup_path_outside_run_state.description: The requested cleanup location overlaps or escapes the run state boundary, so nothing was removed there.
cleanup_path_outside_run_state.recovery: Check the runner state configuration and retained run paths. Do not remove unrelated files to work around this refusal.

mediated_remote_changed.title: The run remote no longer matches its authorized repository
mediated_remote_changed.description: The fixed origin URL or push URL changed from the host-configured mediated remote.
mediated_remote_changed.recovery: Check the existing run state and repository binding before continuing. Do not replace it with a credential-bearing URL.

mediated_remote_install_failed.title: The mediated run remote could not be installed
mediated_remote_install_failed.description: Local Git could not add the fixed remote required by the authorized run.
mediated_remote_install_failed.recovery: Check the run repository and local filesystem access before continuing.

mediated_remote_invalid.title: The mediated run remote could not be inspected
mediated_remote_invalid.description: Local Git could not read the fixed origin configuration safely.
mediated_remote_invalid.recovery: Check the run repository configuration before continuing. Keep provider credentials out of remotes and graph inputs.

git_exclude_invalid.title: The run exclusion file is unavailable
git_exclude_invalid.description: The runner expected a regular private Git exclusion file but found a missing or linked path.
git_exclude_invalid.recovery: Check the retained run repository and filesystem access before continuing.

command_directory_invalid.title: The run command directory changed
command_directory_invalid.description: The command-wrapper directory contains unsupported entries or is a link. The runner refused to install wrappers there.
command_directory_invalid.recovery: Check the retained run directory before starting new work; preserve unrelated files and keep wrappers run-local.

command_wrapper_changed.title: A run command wrapper changed
command_wrapper_changed.description: An existing command wrapper no longer matches the trusted host-generated contents.
command_wrapper_changed.recovery: Check the retained run directory before continuing. Do not replace trusted wrappers with Agent-generated commands.

repository_invalid.title: The repository identifier is invalid
repository_invalid.description: The configured repository does not use the supported owner/name format.
repository_invalid.recovery: Correct the repository identifier in the local configuration before starting new work.

branch_invalid.title: The branch name is invalid
branch_invalid.description: The configured branch name contains unsupported characters or path segments.
branch_invalid.recovery: Choose a supported branch name in the local configuration before starting new work.

git_timeout.title: A local Git operation timed out
git_timeout.description: The Git command exceeded its deadline and process-tree cleanup was confirmed. If it contacted a remote, that operation may still have completed.
git_timeout.recovery: Check the existing run and any remote result before starting new work. Do not blindly repeat a push.

git_timeout_cleanup_unverified.title: A local Git operation timed out and cleanup is uncertain
git_timeout_cleanup_unverified.description: The Git command exceeded its deadline, and the runner could not confirm all related processes stopped. If it contacted a remote, that operation may still be active or completed.
git_timeout_cleanup_unverified.recovery: Check the existing run, local Git processes and any remote result before continuing. Do not retry a push while its outcome is uncertain.

absolute_local_source_required.title: The local source needs an absolute path
absolute_local_source_required.description: A relative path cannot identify an admitted local skill source.
absolute_local_source_required.recovery: Select an absolute local path within the configured allowed source roots.

discovered_revision_required.title: Choose a discovered revision
discovered_revision_required.description: The selected revision was not established by source discovery.
discovered_revision_required.recovery: List the selected skill's revisions and choose an available immutable revision.

discovered_skill_required.title: Choose a discovered skill
discovered_skill_required.description: The selected skill was not established by source discovery.
discovered_skill_required.recovery: Refresh the source choices and choose a discovered skill before listing revisions.

github_discovery_incomplete.title: GitHub returned an incomplete list
github_discovery_incomplete.description: The application could not establish a complete list of matching resources.
github_discovery_incomplete.recovery: Check GitHub connectivity and refresh the read-only selection before choosing a resource.

github_http_401.title: GitHub authentication was refused
github_http_401.description: The configured connection was not accepted by GitHub.
github_http_401.recovery: Check the resource on GitHub and the configured connection's repository access before another operation.

github_http_403.title: GitHub access was refused
github_http_403.description: GitHub did not permit this request for the configured connection.
github_http_403.recovery: Check the resource on GitHub and the configured connection's repository access before another operation.

github_http_404.title: The GitHub resource is unavailable
github_http_404.description: GitHub could not provide the selected resource; it may be missing or inaccessible.
github_http_404.recovery: Check the resource on GitHub and the configured connection's repository access before another operation.

github_http_410.title: The GitHub resource is no longer available
github_http_410.description: GitHub reports that the selected resource is no longer available.
github_http_410.recovery: Check the resource on GitHub and the configured connection's repository access before another operation.

github_issue_unavailable.title: The issue could not be read
github_issue_unavailable.description: The application could not confirm a usable response from the configured service or GitHub.
github_issue_unavailable.recovery: Check service availability and inspect the resource on GitHub. Confirm any existing write outcome before another operation.

github_pr_unavailable.title: The pull request could not be read
github_pr_unavailable.description: The application could not confirm a usable response from the configured service or GitHub.
github_pr_unavailable.recovery: Check service availability and inspect the resource on GitHub. Confirm any existing write outcome before another operation.

invalid_source_operation.title: The skill source action is invalid
invalid_source_operation.description: The requested source action is unsupported.
invalid_source_operation.recovery: Use the supported source discovery, revision listing or resolution action.

issue_grant_unavailable.title: Operation authorization is unavailable
issue_grant_unavailable.description: The host could not confirm authorization for this issue operation.
issue_grant_unavailable.recovery: Check the configured repository connection and operation authorization; keep credentials out of the graph.

issue_operation_conflict.title: The operation identity conflicts with an earlier request
issue_operation_conflict.description: This request identity was already used with different operation inputs.
issue_operation_conflict.recovery: Inspect the earlier request and its outcome. Keep one stable request identity for each intended change.

issue_operation_invalid.title: The issue operation is invalid
issue_operation_invalid.description: The operation payload does not match a supported action or identity contract.
issue_operation_invalid.recovery: Check the Operation input and its supported action fields before submitting a change.

issue_patch_invalid.title: The issue change is invalid
issue_patch_invalid.description: The proposed changes contain unsupported fields or values.
issue_patch_invalid.recovery: Use supported title, body, labels or close changes and inspect the proposal before submission.

issue_reference_mismatch.title: The issue reference does not match
issue_reference_mismatch.description: The supplied reference differs from the selected resource.
issue_reference_mismatch.recovery: Inspect the intended resource and make the node selection and operation reference agree.

issue_response_invalid.title: The issue response could not be verified
issue_response_invalid.description: The returned resource did not match the expected identity or response contract.
issue_response_invalid.recovery: Inspect the resource on GitHub and the existing operation outcome before submitting another operation.

issue_service_not_configured.title: The local issue service is not configured
issue_service_not_configured.description: The local service address or credential-file configuration is invalid.
issue_service_not_configured.recovery: Check the local service configuration before using this node; keep credential contents out of graph inputs.

issue_state_invalid.title: The selection state is invalid
issue_state_invalid.recovery: Choose a supported state on the node.

issue_write_unknown.title: The issue change is not confirmed
issue_write_unknown.description: The request may have reached GitHub, but its final outcome could not be confirmed.
issue_write_unknown.recovery: Inspect the resource on GitHub and the existing operation result before submitting another change. Do not blindly repeat the write.

json_required.title: The source request format is invalid
json_required.description: The local source endpoint requires a JSON request.
json_required.recovery: Use the configured application client or send the supported JSON request format.

labels_invalid.title: The selected labels are invalid
labels_invalid.description: The label selection contains unsupported or repeated values.
labels_invalid.recovery: Select valid labels on the node and inspect the selection before running an operation.

local_source_invalid.title: The local source address is invalid
local_source_invalid.description: The local source URI contains unsupported address parts.
local_source_invalid.recovery: Use an absolute local directory path or a supported file URI.

local_source_not_allowed.title: This local source is not allowed
local_source_not_allowed.description: The selected directory is outside the configured source roots.
local_source_not_allowed.recovery: Select a directory within an allowed root or update the local source service configuration.

local_source_unavailable.title: The local skill source is unavailable
local_source_unavailable.description: The selected local directory could not be used as an admitted source.
local_source_unavailable.recovery: Check that the selected source directory exists and is accessible within an allowed root.

local_source_unsafe.title: The local source could not be read safely
local_source_unsafe.description: The source contains a redirected path or does not meet the local source boundary.
local_source_unsafe.recovery: Select an allowed directory containing ordinary files and directories.

pr_agent_cancelled.title: The PR proposal was cancelled
pr_agent_cancelled.description: The Agent proposal was cancelled before feedback could proceed.
pr_agent_cancelled.recovery: Inspect the existing Agent run and PR; a cancelled proposal does not establish a successful PR change.

pr_agent_failed.title: The Agent did not complete the PR proposal
pr_agent_failed.description: The Agent failed before a usable PR feedback proposal was available.
pr_agent_failed.recovery: Inspect the Agent's run and the current PR before starting another operation.

pr_agent_loop_invalid.title: The PR feedback request is invalid
pr_agent_loop_invalid.description: The Agent feedback request does not match the supported PR operation contract.
pr_agent_loop_invalid.recovery: Inspect the Agent's operation proposal and the selected PR before running feedback.

pr_changed_since_agent_read.title: The PR changed after the Agent read it
pr_changed_since_agent_read.description: The current PR no longer matches the snapshot used for the Agent's proposal.
pr_changed_since_agent_read.recovery: Read the current PR and review a new proposal against that state before applying a change.

pr_feedback_not_configured.title: PR feedback is not configured
pr_feedback_not_configured.description: The local PR service does not provide the authorization needed for Agent feedback.
pr_feedback_not_configured.recovery: Check the local PR feedback configuration and inspect the existing PR before another operation.

pr_feedback_ticket_invalid.title: PR feedback authorization is invalid
pr_feedback_ticket_invalid.description: The supplied feedback ticket could not be accepted for this operation.
pr_feedback_ticket_invalid.recovery: Inspect the existing operation outcome and current PR before requesting new feedback authorization.

pr_grant_unavailable.title: Operation authorization is unavailable
pr_grant_unavailable.description: The host could not confirm authorization for this pull request operation.
pr_grant_unavailable.recovery: Check the configured repository connection and operation authorization; keep credentials out of the graph.

pr_operation_conflict.title: The operation identity conflicts with an earlier request
pr_operation_conflict.description: This request identity was already used with different operation inputs.
pr_operation_conflict.recovery: Inspect the earlier request and its outcome. Keep one stable request identity for each intended change.

pr_operation_invalid.title: The pull request operation is invalid
pr_operation_invalid.description: The operation payload does not match a supported action or identity contract.
pr_operation_invalid.recovery: Check the Operation input and its supported action fields before submitting a change.

pr_patch_invalid.title: The pull request change is invalid
pr_patch_invalid.description: The proposed changes contain unsupported fields or values.
pr_patch_invalid.recovery: Use supported title, body, labels or close changes and inspect the proposal before submission.

pr_reference_mismatch.title: The pull request reference does not match
pr_reference_mismatch.description: The supplied reference differs from the selected resource.
pr_reference_mismatch.recovery: Inspect the intended resource and make the node selection and operation reference agree.

pr_response_invalid.title: The pull request response could not be verified
pr_response_invalid.description: The returned resource did not match the expected identity or response contract.
pr_response_invalid.recovery: Inspect the resource on GitHub and the existing operation outcome before submitting another operation.

pr_service_not_configured.title: The local pull request service is not configured
pr_service_not_configured.description: The local service address or credential-file configuration is invalid.
pr_service_not_configured.recovery: Check the local service configuration before using this node; keep credential contents out of graph inputs.

pr_state_invalid.title: The selection state is invalid
pr_state_invalid.recovery: Choose a supported state on the node.

pr_write_unknown.title: The pull request change is not confirmed
pr_write_unknown.description: The request may have reached GitHub, but its final outcome could not be confirmed.
pr_write_unknown.recovery: Inspect the resource on GitHub and the existing operation result before submitting another change. Do not blindly repeat the write.

repository_access_unavailable.title: The skill repository could not be read
repository_access_unavailable.description: The source service could not complete its bounded Git repository read.
repository_access_unavailable.recovery: Check that the selected HTTPS source is accessible and supported by the local source service.

repository_connection_unavailable.title: The repository connection is unavailable
repository_connection_unavailable.description: The configured GitHub connection does not provide access to this repository.
repository_connection_unavailable.recovery: Check the configured GitHub connection and select a repository it can access.

repository_limit_exceeded.title: The skill repository read exceeded a limit
repository_limit_exceeded.description: The repository operation exceeded its time, output or local cache budget.
repository_limit_exceeded.recovery: Use a smaller supported source and check the local source service's available storage.

repository_revision_unavailable.title: No usable repository revision is available
repository_revision_unavailable.description: The source did not provide a usable branch or tag revision.
repository_revision_unavailable.recovery: Check the source repository's branches and tags before refreshing its revisions.

repository_url_invalid.title: The repository URL is invalid
repository_url_invalid.description: The selected source has an unsupported or malformed repository URL.
repository_url_invalid.recovery: Enter an HTTPS repository URL supported by this node.

selected_issue_invalid.title: The selected issue is invalid
selected_issue_invalid.description: The selected issue number cannot be used.
selected_issue_invalid.recovery: Select an available issue from the configured repository.

selected_issue_no_longer_matches.title: The issue no longer matches the selection
selected_issue_no_longer_matches.description: The current resource no longer matches the node's labels or state filter.
selected_issue_no_longer_matches.recovery: Read the current issue and update the selection before proposing another change.

selected_issue_required.title: Select an issue
selected_issue_required.description: This operation needs a selected issue.
selected_issue_required.recovery: Choose the intended issue on the node before running the operation.

selected_label_unavailable.title: A selected label is no longer available
selected_label_unavailable.description: A selected label is missing from the repository's current labels.
selected_label_unavailable.recovery: Update the node's label selection using the repository's current labels.

selected_pr_invalid.title: The selected pull request is invalid
selected_pr_invalid.description: The selected pull request number cannot be used.
selected_pr_invalid.recovery: Select an available pull request from the configured repository.

selected_pr_no_longer_matches.title: The pull request no longer matches the selection
selected_pr_no_longer_matches.description: The current resource no longer matches the node's labels or state filter.
selected_pr_no_longer_matches.recovery: Read the current pull request and update the selection before proposing another change.

selected_pr_required.title: Select a pull request
selected_pr_required.description: This operation needs a selected pull request.
selected_pr_required.recovery: Choose the intended pull request on the node before running the operation.

skill_name_invalid.title: The skill name is invalid
skill_name_invalid.description: The skill's declared name cannot be used as a registry identity.
skill_name_invalid.recovery: Use the supported lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores in the skill name.

skill_operation_refused.title: The skill operation was refused
skill_operation_refused.description: The local service could not accept this Skill operation; private parser and authorization details were withheld.
skill_operation_refused.recovery: Inspect the selected revision and proposed edits. Confirm the existing operation outcome before submitting another change.

skill_operation_service_not_configured.title: The skill operation service is not configured
skill_operation_service_not_configured.description: The local operation service address or requested action is invalid.
skill_operation_service_not_configured.recovery: Check the configured local Skill operation service before using editing or history actions.

skill_operation_unavailable.title: The skill operation result is unavailable
skill_operation_unavailable.description: The application could not confirm a usable response from the local Skill operation service.
skill_operation_unavailable.recovery: Check local service availability and inspect the existing revision/history before submitting another edit.

source_bundle_invalid.title: The skill bundle is incomplete or unsupported
source_bundle_invalid.description: The selected bundle does not meet the supported Skill file structure and limits.
source_bundle_invalid.recovery: Select a complete skill directory containing SKILL.md.

source_bundle_unsafe.title: The skill bundle contains an unsafe path
source_bundle_unsafe.description: A source file path or file type is excluded by the Skill source boundary.
source_bundle_unsafe.recovery: Use a skill directory containing supported ordinary files without secret files or redirected paths.

source_discovery_failed.title: Skill source discovery was refused
source_discovery_failed.description: The local source service refused the discovery request.
source_discovery_failed.recovery: Check the selected source and its allowed-root or repository configuration before refreshing choices.

source_limit_exceeded.title: The skill source exceeded a limit
source_limit_exceeded.description: The source exceeded the supported file, size, depth or discovery budget.
source_limit_exceeded.recovery: Select a smaller skill source that fits the documented source limits.

source_reference_invalid.title: The skill source reference does not match
source_reference_invalid.description: The cached source choice and immutable revision identity disagree.
source_reference_invalid.recovery: Refresh the source and reselect the intended immutable skill revision.

source_required.title: Choose a skill source
source_required.description: No usable skill source was supplied.
source_required.recovery: Enter a supported repository URL or an allowed absolute local path on the Skill node.

source_service_not_configured.title: The skill source service is not configured
source_service_not_configured.description: The local source service address is missing or invalid.
source_service_not_configured.recovery: Check the local Skill source service configuration before discovering a source.

source_service_unavailable.title: The skill source service is unavailable
source_service_unavailable.description: The application could not confirm a usable response from the local source service.
source_service_unavailable.recovery: Check that the configured local source service is available before refreshing source choices.

source_unavailable.title: The skill source could not be read
source_unavailable.description: The source service could not safely complete this request.
source_unavailable.recovery: Check the selected source and local source service availability before refreshing read-only choices.

bundle_not_regular.title: The handoff bundle is not a regular file
bundle_not_regular.description: The local publication stage refused the run's fixed handoff file because it is missing, redirected or not a regular file.
bundle_not_regular.recovery: Check the existing run and publication attempt before starting new work. A refused capture does not authorize publishing or retrying an uncertain remote operation.

bundle_size_or_type.title: The handoff bundle was refused
bundle_size_or_type.description: The local publication stage refused the handoff file because its type, link count or size is outside the supported limits.
bundle_size_or_type.recovery: Check the existing run and publication attempt before starting new work. A refused capture does not authorize publishing or retrying an uncertain remote operation.

bundle_changed_or_oversized.title: The handoff bundle changed while being read
bundle_changed_or_oversized.description: The local publication stage could not retain stable, bounded bytes from the handoff file. This capture was refused.
bundle_changed_or_oversized.recovery: Check the existing run and publication attempt before starting new work. A refused capture does not authorize publishing or retrying an uncertain remote operation.

bundle_unreadable.title: The handoff bundle could not be read
bundle_unreadable.description: The local publication stage encountered a filesystem error while reading the run's fixed handoff file. This capture was refused.
bundle_unreadable.recovery: Check the existing run and publication attempt before starting new work. A refused capture does not authorize publishing or retrying an uncertain remote operation.

unsafe_relative_path.title: A skill file path is unsafe
unsafe_relative_path.description: A skill file path is absolute, contains an unsupported separator or attempts to leave its skill folder. The registry refused that path.
unsafe_relative_path.recovery: Use relative file paths inside the skill, then select or import a verified revision.

invalid_tree_root.title: The skill folder is unavailable
invalid_tree_root.description: The registry could not use the expected skill folder as a regular directory. It may be missing or linked to another location.
invalid_tree_root.recovery: Check the selected skill source and registry files before selecting or importing a verified revision.

linked_path.title: The skill contains a linked path
linked_path.description: The registry found a symbolic link, junction or reparse point inside the skill folder and refused to follow it.
linked_path.recovery: Use a skill revision containing regular files and folders without links.

special_file.title: The skill contains an unsupported file
special_file.description: The registry found a filesystem entry that is not a regular file or directory. It refused to include that entry in the skill.
special_file.recovery: Remove unsupported filesystem entries from the source and import a verified skill revision.

hardlinked_file.title: The skill contains a hard-linked file
hardlinked_file.description: A skill file shares its filesystem contents with another path. The registry refused it because another path could change those bytes.
hardlinked_file.recovery: Use independent regular files in the source and import a verified skill revision.

missing_skill_file.title: The skill is missing SKILL.md
missing_skill_file.description: The expected skill folder does not contain its required SKILL.md file. The registry could not verify a complete skill revision.
missing_skill_file.recovery: Check the selected source or registry revision and use a skill with a SKILL.md file at its root.

empty_directory.title: The skill contains an empty folder
empty_directory.description: The registry found an empty folder that cannot be represented by the skill file inventory. It refused the tree.
empty_directory.recovery: Remove empty folders from the source or add their intended files, then import a verified skill revision.
